quarterly_data.quarter: Novo Nordisk press release: Novo and Hengrui Pharma enter exclusive license agreement (09-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Licensor Hengrui Pharma: Novo Nordisk entered a license agreement with Hengrui Pharma (600276.SH; 01276.HK) for HRS-1596, a phase 1-ready GLP-1 receptor and GIP receptor dual agonist with potential for once-weekly oral dosing. Novo obtains exclusive rights to develop, manufacture and commercialise HRS-1596 globally, excluding mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan. The potential total value is up to 2.6 billion US dollars contingent on development, regulatory and commercial milestones, including a 300 million dollars upfront payment, plus royalties to Hengrui on net sales in the licensed territory. Hengrui has received approval in China to initiate phase 1 trials of HRS-1596 for weight management and type 2 diabetes. The agreement is subject to U.S. Hart-Scott-Rodino clearance and other customary closing conditions and is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026. CSO Martin Holst Lange said Novo is excited to add HRS-1596 to its growing oral pipeline across obesity, diabetes and other cardiometabolic diseases and to explore its potential to raise the bar for convenience.
quarterly_data.figure: up to 2.6 billion US dollars total potential value, including 300 million dollars upfront, plus royalties; expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026
